title: Uncertainty matrix and continuous model-scouting cadence for competitive tracking
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Problem: We lack a single, actionable view that combines model supply uncertainty (availability, deprecation risk, quant compatibility), customer latency sensitivity, and cost arbitrage to guide procurement and fallback decisions. Goal: deliver an uncertainty matrix + operational scouting cadence that surfaces high-risk model gaps and automates signals into the Model Watchtower feed. This ticket scopes the PM work to design the matrix, define signal sources, build the scouting cadence, and deliver a PRD + dashboard spec for eng to implement. Deliverables: 1) Uncertainty matrix specification (dimensions, scoring, thresholds). 2) Data signal catalogue (telemetry, marketplace, vendor release cadence, P95 latency deltas, quantization availability). 3) Weekly scouting cadence runbook (roles, channel templates, triage thresholds). 4) PRD with acceptance criteria and success metrics. 5) Wireframe for Watchtower dashboard and alerting rules.
acceptance_criteria: Uncertainty matrix spec doc published and reviewed by SRE, Research, and Procurement
Signal catalogue with at least 8 distinct signals (telemetry + external) and ingestion plan
Runbook that describes weekly scouting workflow and owner rotation published
Dashboard wireframe (Figma link) that visualizes model risk buckets and drilldowns
Three alert rules defined and validated against historical incidents (simulated)
Metrics defined: time-to-detect supply shock, false positive rate for alerts, and coverage of top-10 customer-critical models
